sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 4x + 7$ in solving systems of equations with the elimination method, evaluate $f(5)$.
questions.target: Solving systems of equations with the elimination method

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 13x + 36 = 0$.
questions.target: Solving systems of equations with the elimination method
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 4$ and $x = 9$. Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 9) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 9$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 8$ in solving systems of equations with a variety of methods, evaluate $f(2)$.

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
questions.target: Solving systems of equations with a variety of methods
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 1$ and $x = 3$. Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 3) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 3$.

questions.q: A data set recorded for solving systems of equations with a variety of methods consists of the four values $\{15, 19, 23, 29\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Solving systems of equations with a variety of methods
questions.answer: Final Answer: $21.5$. The sum is $15 + 19 + 23 + 29 = 86$, and dividing by $4$ gives $21.5$.
questions.explanation: The sum is $15 + 19 + 23 + 29 = 86$, and dividing by $4$ gives $21.5$.
